For current families

Get the right link, from the right place.

01

School updates

Ask the office which channel currently carries class notices, schedules and parent communication.

02

Parent access

For a parent app or login, request the official link and setup guidance directly from the school. Do not use a guessed or forwarded login link.

03

Fee-payment help

Confirm the current payment method, amount and recipient with the school before paying. This website does not collect payments.

Never share passwords, OTPs, card details or identity documents through an enquiry form.
